items.prompt: What does a wide frame in a CPU sampling flame graph primarily show?

options.text: A long chronological interval on its x-axis
options.why: The ordinary flame graph x-axis is not a time line.

options.text: Frequent occurrence in the sampled stack population
options.why: Width reflects sample population under that collection setup.

options.text: A proven lock wait with zero CPU activity
options.why: On-CPU samples alone do not establish off-CPU waits.

options.text: A guarantee that deleting the function is safe
options.why: Correctness and required work still govern changes.

items.explanation: Interpret the collection and axes before using the graph as a bottleneck hypothesis.
